discovery_notes: Follow-up to 256 (b075); reuses its keys (and 257 for shared NBC puzzle, DL65). 29 standard searches, snippets only. Holds resolved: Dec 2020 Pinocchio Wish, Figaro & Cleo, Ariel maker = Uncas International (per-pin DPB snippets); DL65 'mystery set' lead = DL65 Puzzle blind box. Holds kept: Perfume, Mulan, Pixar Bows, NBC Puzzle, Soft Serve (forum lead only), Sleeping Beauty (new). New: Child Pod (Jan), Protect Attack Snack (Jul), Sassy Marie (Aug), DL65 Puzzle set (Sep), Mickey Pastel Glitter (Oct), Cinderella HEA 2-pin set, Jar Jar Jar, Sleeping Beauty blind box (Nov). Child with Soup maker still unknown. No Apr-Jun 2020 BoxLunch pins found. Sleeping Beauty key matches concurrent packet 280 lead key (loungefly-boxlunch-sleeping-beauty-blind-box).
